_about: T.S.R.A. Field Clearance: the player's standing with the agency, raised by Research Yield (RY) that the field scanner files on every new reading (scripts/GameLogicEngine/asra_clearance.gd). tiers: in order, each reached once lifetime yield hits its "yield"; "brief" is the line the promotion notice shows. A tier may grant an "unlock" ({id, name, text}) that stays on from that tier up; the game checks it with Clearance.has_unlock(id): classified (the CLASSIFIED ANNEX in the dossiers), rangefinder (the scanner's signal range and bearing), deep_scan (a locked reading reports what the anomaly is doing right now). The yield rules themselves (what a reading is worth and its modifiers) live in the script's constants.

tiers.title: PROVISIONAL CONTRACTOR
tiers.brief: Onboarding in progress. Field scanner issued on a probationary licence.

tiers.title: ASSOCIATE FIELD SURVEYOR
tiers.brief: Probation lifted. Scanner calibration patch pushed to your unit.

tiers.title: FIELD ANALYST
tiers.brief: Your readings now count toward agency quotas. Redacted material is released to you.

unlock.name: CLASSIFIED ANNEXES
unlock.text: Redacted dossier and entry sections are now readable: origins, survival protocols, incident reports.

tiers.title: SENIOR FIELD ANALYST
tiers.brief: Cross-level telemetry access granted. Your scanner has been upgraded.

unlock.name: SCANNER RANGE-FINDER
unlock.text: While searching, the scanner now reports how far away a signal is and which way to turn.

tiers.title: THRESHOLD SPECIALIST
tiers.brief: You are now cleared for unescorted deep-level survey.

unlock.name: DEEP SCAN
unlock.text: A locked reading now reports what the anomaly is doing right now, and whether it is after you.

tiers.title: PRINCIPAL INVESTIGATOR
tiers.brief: Dossier authorship rights granted. Your findings set directive policy.

tiers.title: DIRECTOR, NON-EUCLIDEAN OPS
tiers.brief: There is no further clearance. There is no way back up. Welcome to the board.
